guarantees: Dedicated key and pinned host key; forced-command-only SSH
Durable storage acknowledgement distinct from notification acceptance
Request ID and content hash deduplication; original retained on missing acknowledgement
Independent worker state and provider credentials inaccessible to ingress
Sanitized report returned with original completion time; rollback refused
limitations: Production host provisioning and timers not deployed
Transfer and worker stop monitoring not yet integrated
Inbox limited to 10000 records; archival procedure not automated
WordPress browser UI uses the previously tested request/report schema; this run tests the two-host transport
